text.tspan: Share of workers in informal employment vs. GDP per capita 2025
Share of employed people working in jobs that lack basic social or legal protection and employment benefits.
Does not include illegal and illicit activities. Figures refer to national estimates and may not be fully comparable
across countries. GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Share of workers in informal employment

tspan.tspan: International Labour Organization; Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods for own use, such as subsistence farming. GDP

text.tspan: per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2015
